visualCharacteristics.purpose: tabbed panel where one tab shows circular profile photos with links and another a multi-column link list
visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-width grey tab band with a solid-blue active tab. The first panel is a row of circular profile photos with uppercase links; the second is a 4-column link list.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: tab label; cell 2: tab content (images with links become a profile row; a list becomes a 1-2-4 column link grid)
contentPattern.notes: An interactive tabbed component. Both tab labels and the full content of both panels are kept.

usage: Lo que te interesa: audience profiles (Para ti) and district links (En tu distrito).
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any tabbed content whose panels are photo link rows or long link lists.
